loan.title: Loans and advances
loan.list.description: Your loans and advances. HR and finance see the loans in their data scope.
loan.apply.title: Apply for a loan or advance
loan.apply.intro: Check your application first: you see the installments and any reason it cannot go ahead before you send it.
loan.field.principal.help: In the currency of your pay group, for example 120000 or 120000.50.
loan.field.principal.invalid: Give a number, with at most four decimals.
loan.field.installments.help: One installment is taken from each pay period.
loan.field.employee: Employee number (only when you apply for someone else)
loan.field.guarantor.help: Needed when the loan type asks for a guarantor; the guarantor must agree.
loan.type.none: No loan type is open for applications.
loan.result.eligible: This loan can be applied for.
loan.result.notEligible: This loan cannot be applied for yet.
loan.preview.max: Most that may be lent to you: {amount}
loan.preview.method.reducing: Interest on the reducing balance, {rate} percent a year
loan.preview.amountsHidden: Amounts are hidden: you need access to salary data to see them.
loan.schedule.empty: The installments are built when the loan is approved.
loan.amounts.hidden: Amounts are hidden: you need access to salary data to see them.
loan.disburse.title: Record the payout of loan {no}
loan.disburse.help: Record the day the money was paid and its payment reference. Installments are taken from payroll from now on.
loan.receipt.title: Record a repayment of loan {no}
loan.receipt.help: A repayment received outside payroll waits for a second person to approve it.
loan.receipt.sent: The repayment was sent to a second person for approval.
loan.receipt.waiting: A repayment is waiting for approval.
loan.cancel.body: The loan was approved but not paid out. Cancelling removes its installments.
loan.error.generic: The request could not be completed.
loan.error.network: The server could not be reached.
loan.notFound: This loan does not exist or is not in your scope.
loan.types.description: Each loan type names its rules (a loan policy) and the deduction that takes its installments from pay.
loan.types.help.policy: The loan policy that holds the rules of this type: who may borrow, how much, interest and the longest repayment.
loan.types.help.component: The pay component of kind deduction that takes the installments.
loan.rep.title: Loan reports
loan.rep.denied: You may not see the loan reports.
loan.rep.rec.ok: The ledger agrees with the schedule.
loan.rep.rec.bad: The ledger and the schedule differ for {count} loans:
loan.rep.rec.none: No loan has been paid out yet.
loan.rep.rec.note: Finance's own account is compared with this once Finance is in use.
loan.card.title: Loan
loan.card.unavailable: The loan details could not be shown.
loan.types.activated: Loan type {type} is open for applications.
